meta.title: Bistro, bo bun, banh mi and infused rum in Amiens | Le Piccassiette
meta.description: Le Piccassiette, a neighbourhood bistro at 9 rue Duméril in Amiens: sandwiches, bo bun and banh mi at lunch, to take away or eat in, then drinks, sharing boards and house-infused rum in the evening. Rated 4.8/5 on Google.

carte.title: Enough to keep you going till evening.
carte.intro: At lunch we eat. In the evening we raise a glass. Prices are right here in real text, not in a blurry photo.
carte.allergens: Allergens: the list is available at the counter. Got an allergy? Tell us when you order.
carte.rhumsEmpty: They change as the jars come and go: the list is on the board behind the bar.

banh-mi.name: Banh mi
banh-mi.desc: Crusty baguette, marinated filling, crunchy pickled veg and fresh herbs. The Vietnamese sandwich, made right here.

bo-bun.name: Bo bun
bo-bun.desc: Rice vermicelli, raw veg, herbs, peanuts and our own sauce. Fresh, generous, and it travels well to the office.

sandwich.name: Sandwich of the moment
sandwich.desc: A home-made sandwich whose recipe follows the market. Ask what today's is.

salade.name: The big salad
salade.desc: A well-loaded mixed salad, for a fresh lunch that still fills you up.

plat-du-jour.name: Dish of the day
plat-du-jour.desc: The hot dish chalked on the board this morning. Give us a ring and we'll tell you what it is.

tartiflette.name: Tartiflette
tartiflette.desc: Potatoes, melting reblochon cheese, bacon and onions. It's back as soon as the weather turns cold.

planche.name: Sharing board
planche.desc: Something to nibble on with a drink. Small or large, depending on how hungry the table is.

verres.name: Wine, beer and soft drinks
verres.desc: By the glass or by the bottle, with a board or to wrap up the week.

rhum-arrange.name: House-infused rum
rhum-arrange.desc: Fruit, spices and rum, left to steep for weeks in our jars. Served by the glass.

midi.title: Quick, and properly good.
midi.text: Banh mi, bo bun, sandwich of the moment. Order before you leave the office and it's ready when you arrive.

apero.title: A board, an infused rum, and the week is done.
apero.text: In the evening the bistro changes mood. The jars come out, the boards land on the tables. Until 11:30 pm on Fridays.

privat.title: A birthday? The bistro is yours.
privat.text: Leaving drinks, birthdays, reunions. Tell us the date and how many of you, and we'll see what we can do.

reviews.title: Rated {value}/5 by {count} guests on Google.
reviews.text: What comes up most: the bo bun, the banh mi, the sandwiches, the tartiflette, the infused rum and the welcome.

infos.title: Rue Duméril, right in the centre.
infos.accessText: Right in the centre of Amiens. Easiest on foot, by bike or by bus. Several public car parks in the centre are a few minutes' walk away.

items.a: Tuesday and Thursday 9:30 am to 10 pm, Wednesday 9:30 am to 2:30 pm, Friday 9:30 am to 11:30 pm and Saturday 10:30 am to 3 pm. Closed on Sundays and Mondays. Any extra closures are announced at the top of the site.

items.q: How do I order for lunch?
items.a: Pick your dishes and a pickup time in the “Order for lunch” form, or call 03 22 22 00 15. You collect, you pay on site.

items.q: How long does an order take?
items.a: Allow at least 20 minutes. The form only offers times that are still possible, between 11:30 am and 2 pm.

items.q: Do I need to book for drinks?
items.a: You don't have to, but it's safer on Friday nights and whenever you come as a group. The “Book for drinks” form takes two minutes.
On site, when you collect your order or at the end of your meal.

items.q: Can we hire the bistro for a birthday?
items.a: We're happy to talk about it. Leave the date and number of guests in the drinks form, or call us, and we'll see together what's possible.

midi.metaTitle: Bo bun and banh mi in Amiens, eat in or take away | Le Piccassiette
midi.metaDescription: Craving a bo bun or a banh mi in Amiens? Le Piccassiette on rue Duméril makes them every lunchtime, to eat in or take away. Order online.
midi.lead: A bowl of bo bun, a banh mi with a proper crunch. At lunchtime in central Amiens, Le Piccassiette takes care of your break.

sections.p: Rice vermicelli, raw veg, fresh herbs, peanuts and our own sauce. Fresh, generous, and one of the dishes our guests mention most.
The Vietnamese sandwich: a crusty baguette, a marinated filling, crunchy veg and herbs. We make it here, to order.
Grab a seat at the bistro or order online: choose a pickup time between 11:30 am and 2 pm, collect it and pay on site.
The sandwich of the moment, a big salad, the dish of the day and, when it gets cold, tartiflette.

apero.title: Drinks and infused rum in Amiens
apero.metaTitle: Evening drinks and house-infused rum in Amiens | Le Piccassiette, bistro
apero.metaDescription: Drinks in Amiens? Sharing boards and house-infused rum at Le Piccassiette, rue Duméril. Tuesday and Thursday until 10 pm, Friday until 11:30 pm.
apero.lead: Jars of rum steeping behind the bar, boards to share, a proper neighbourhood bistro feel. Evening drinks, Piccassiette style.

sections.p: Fruit, spices, rum and a lot of patience. The flavours change as the jars come and go: ask what's on, we'll let you taste.
Something to nibble on together with a glass of wine, a beer or a soft drink. Small or large, depending on the table.
Tuesday and Thursday until 10 pm, Friday until 11:30 pm. On Friday nights, booking is a good idea.
The bistro can welcome your group. Tell us the date and the number of guests, and we'll work it out together.
